description: Data-only plugin UI evaluation, authoritative types and bounds live in flare-plugin-protocol/ui.rs.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Typed UI evaluation envelope defined by the shared UI protocol. presentPluginMessage and invokePluginAction accept an optional messageId (server id or clientMsgId) of the message the card belongs to: present overlays the plugin state stored on that message, invoke stores a successful operation's data.messageState on it.
